subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should the remaining WebChat reconnect active-run preservation be implemented by reviving the open recovery PR, by a new current-main replacement, or by declaring current partial mitigations sufficient?
rationale: Current main has partial source-backed mitigations, but the unresolved behavior spans Gateway protocol/session state and Control UI run adoption; choosing the durable contract and whether to preserve the stale PR branch needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Open a current-main replacement
options.body: Implement active-run recovery against the current packages/gateway-protocol and ui/src/pages/chat surfaces, crediting the open PR where useful and requiring live reconnect proof.

options.title: Revive the open PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase the PR, move protocol changes to the live package, address prior findings, and add real behavior proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigations
options.body: Close only if maintainers explicitly decide that Stop/Queue visibility and queued-send retry are sufficient without adopting an active run id after reconnect.

recommendation.title: Open a current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Implement active-run recovery against the current packages/gateway-protocol and ui/src/pages/chat surfaces, crediting the open PR where useful and requiring live reconnect proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main session/thread and protocol work makes this the best available owner for the active-run reconnect contract decision.
